statement: (∀ (q a n : ℕ), 1 ≤ q → q ≤ 105 → Nat.Coprime a q → 10^16 ≤ n → (n:ℝ) < Real.exp (Real.exp (19/5)) → |(∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k % q = a % q), (if k.Prime then ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k else 0)) - (n:ℝ)/Nat.totient q| ≤ (n:ℝ)/200) → (∀ n : ℕ, 10^16 ≤ n → (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (if k.Prime then 0 else ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k)) ≤ (n:ℝ)/200) → (∀ (q a n : ℕ), 1 ≤ q → q ≤ 105 → Nat.Coprime a q → 10^16 ≤ n → (n:ℝ) < Real.exp (Real.exp (19/5)) → |(∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k % q = a % q), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k) - (n:ℝ)/Nat.totient q| ≤ (n:ℝ)/100)

plain_statement.zh: 合并素数与高次幂的两个半预算，推出 FR-7022
plain_statement.en: Combine the prime and higher-power budgets for FR-7022

brief.zh: 一个剩余类内的非素数权重非负且至多为全局总量。把两个 n/200 相加，得到原声明要求的 n/100。
brief.en: The nonprime weight in each class is nonnegative and bounded by the global sum. Adding the two n/200 budgets gives the original n/100.
